title: Crown v10 Gemini Vision QA Score
summary: Gemini Vision 9/10 QA score for Crown v10 HVAC video.
content:
Crown v10 - Gemini Vision QA Score

This HVAC video scores a 9/10.

The video effectively uses a split-screen layout and text overlays ("BEFORE," "THE PROCESS," "AFTER") to clearly demonstrate the problem, the solution, and the result. The "BEFORE" shots clearly show damaged or worn-out components, establishing the need for the service. "THE PROCESS" section, with its close-ups of technicians working on the units, highlights the professionalism and thoroughness of the work. The "AFTER" shots showcase the newly installed or repaired components, emphasizing the quality of the outcome.

The inclusion of a "CTA" (Call to Action) is crucial for converting viewers into customers. The visual progression is easy to follow, even without audio, making it highly effective for quick consumption on various platforms. The consistent branding (e.g., "TECH" on the equipment) subtly reinforces the company's presence.

To make it a 10/10, a slightly more dynamic "THE PROCESS" section with perhaps a time-lapse or more varied angles could further enhance engagement. However, as it stands, it's a very strong and informative video.
